definition: OwnerCommitmentAt o concrete hasCausalPower w retains BOTH PowerRequiresConcreteAt (∀ x, hasCausalPower w x → concrete x) and CausersRequireConcreteAt (∀ x y, o.Causes w x y → concrete x). Concrete status is independent of the power predicate and Ontic.Causes. Power means ability to cause, including unexercised ability. It is not mathematical implication or generic explanatory relevance. Concrete status does not require materiality or spatial location; an immaterial causal agent is permitted. No cause-to-power implication is needed to state these independent commitments.
note: The constraint is an OPEN owner-proposed philosophical input, not a definition of concrete as powerful. No power-to-existence interface, global modal law, concrete-to-power converse or causal/grounding coverage is assumed. The independent predicates may be instantiated only with their intended meanings; actual applicability remains open. docs/notes/causal-power-concreteness.md records examples, exclusions, rivals and remaining bridges.
